name: Musumate
source:
This is the story of your daughter, Minatsu, whom you've just started living with and your niece, Yuka, whom you'll be taking care of for a while, due to certain circumstances. How will you spend your time with them?

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0056590]DiGiket[/url]]
